title: Brad Pitt let his neighbour live rent-free until 105; the unusual story behind his former LA mansion
summary_full: In a heartwarming gesture, Brad Pitt purchased a home from an elderly neighbor, allowing him to live there rent-free until he reached the remarkable age of 105. Over the years, Pitt amassed several properties to form his Los Feliz compound, displaying a keen interest in architecture. Recently, he sold his estate in Los Feliz for around $33 million, marking a significant milestone in his real estate journey.
